title: Import VB6 Legacy System Artifacts
problem_statement: VB6 modernization project lacks essential source artifacts including forms (.frm), modules (.bas), classes (.cls), and project files
risk_if_unaddressed: Cannot perform modernization analysis or generate C# conversion without VB6 source code
suggested_approach: 1. Locate and import VB6 project files 2. Run VBDepend analysis export 3. Update repository with legacy artifacts 4. Re-run SIL analysis
success_criteria: VB6 source files present in repository

provenance.evidence: No VB6 file extensions in 122 scanned files

title: Define Database Migration Schema Contracts
problem_statement: Microsoft Access to PostgreSQL migration lacks source schema definition and target schema design
risk_if_unaddressed: Data migration will fail without proper schema mapping and validation
suggested_approach: 1. Extract Access database schema 2. Design PostgreSQL target schema 3. Create migration scripts 4. Define rollback procedures

provenance.evidence: Empty SQL sections in database conversion context

title: Implement API Security Framework
problem_statement: FastAPI endpoints lack authentication, authorization, and security controls
risk_if_unaddressed: Unauthorized access to modernization platform and sensitive legacy system data
suggested_approach: 1. Implement JWT authentication 2. Add role-based authorization 3. Secure API endpoints 4. Add security audit logging

title: Standardize Agent Error Handling
problem_statement: Inconsistent error handling patterns across agent modules reduce reliability and debugging capability
risk_if_unaddressed: Unpredictable failures and difficult troubleshooting during modernization execution
suggested_approach: 1. Define standard error handling patterns 2. Implement base exception classes 3. Add consistent logging 4. Update all agent modules

provenance.evidence: Varied error handling approaches across modules

title: Implement Comprehensive Testing Framework
problem_statement: Tester agent exists but lacks testing framework, coverage requirements, and validation criteria
risk_if_unaddressed: Modernization quality cannot be validated without proper testing infrastructure
suggested_approach: 1. Define testing strategy 2. Implement test frameworks 3. Create validation criteria 4. Add coverage requirements
